rulings.model: The IRS fills line 5 only in some cases: line 4 "Yes. Skip line 5", and the threshold test "Yes. Leave line 5 blank". The credit on line 6 is unaffected because line 6 applies the blank condition.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained.
